highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and updates the bundled renderer to Skia m152.
highlights_body: The release also adds asynchronous GPU readback, restores Vulkan Silk.NET packages, and improves native asset and lifetime reliability across supported platforms.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled rendering engine to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent upstream stability and servicing fixes.
Adds bindings for Graphite on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling applications to use Skia's newer GPU rendering architecture.
SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels operations for GPU readback workflows.
Restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and its native package production for consumers using Silk.NET Vulkan integration.

bullets.lead: Pixel and iterator sources remain alive
bullets.detail: Prevents native use-after-free failures when using SKRegion span iterators and SKPixmap subset or transformation operations.

bullets.lead: Failed raster image creation releases buffers
bullets.detail: Correctly releases CoTaskMem pixel buffers when SKImage.Create cannot create a raster image.

bullets.lead: Runtime effect resets release prior uniform buffers
bullets.detail: Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes the previously allocated uniform buffer instead of retaining it.
Reduces unnecessary copying, boxing, reflection, and temporary strings in shaping, tag formatting, data saving, and runtime-effect lookups.
Makes generated bindings deterministic across build platforms, improving consistency for consumers building SkiaSharp from source.
Produces Apple native symbol packages and uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-backed font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m152 release line with Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, Vulkan Silk.NET support, and managed reliability improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added m152 servicing updates, native symbol packages, and fixes for runtime-effect and HarfBuzz resource handling.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves shaping performance by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and fixes disposal of non-memory-backed stream assets used to create HarfBuzz blobs.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite GPU bindings and the Skia m152 engine update.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback, Vulkan Silk.NET support, and reliability improvements for managed and native resources.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the m152 release with servicing and reliability updates.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It includes Apple native symbols, improved HarfBuzz resource cleanup, and fixes for runtime-effect uniform buffers.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 is the stable release built on the Skia m152 renderer.
v4.152.0.body: It delivers Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, Vulkan Silk.NET support, and managed lifetime improvements.
